name: The Sorcerer's Spire
author: Patchwork
description: A black glass tower that drinks the light. Supplies a sorcerer with motives of power and darkness, an orb of darkness, a shard of star-glass, a shadow ward that only true light can break, lore, and an 'eclipse' event that any light-giving item from any mod can resolve. The tower only appears if the story needs it.
